Frequently Asked Questions (Amazon FBA Calc)

What is a good net profit margin for Amazon FBA in 2026?

Experienced US FBA sellers target at least 20%–30% net margin after referral fees, FBA fulfillment, storage, and blended PPC (TACoS), alongside 80%–100%+ ROI on landed inventory cost.

How do I reconcile Amazon bi-weekly FBA settlements cleanly for taxes?

Amazon bundles gross sales, refunds, FBA fees, storage, and PPC charges into one lump-sum deposit. Bookkeeping sync tools like Link My Books split every settlement into exact QuickBooks/Xero lines automatically.
